record.question:
L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circle facing the centre. N, who is third to the left of
    P, is not a neighbour of M. S is the neighbour of O and R is third to the right of M. L is not the
    neighbor of O, who is second to the left of N. Which of the following is not true?
options: N, L and O are adjacent to each other
M,P and O,S are pairs of adjacent persons
L is on the immediate left of M
record.explanation: Source/key conflict: the circular-seating clues admit multiple arrangements. For example, clockwise L, N, R, O, S, M, P, Q satisfies every clue while both option (A) and option (D) are false. Exhaustive enumeration gives four arrangements after fixing L's position. The Commission's provisional key marks (A), but the printed task is underdetermined; scoring is withheld pending clarification.
record.direction:
Time Allowed : 2 hours. Maximum Marks : 200.
This Question Booklet contains 100 questions carrying 2 marks each. Each item comprises of four alternative responses to choose for answer. Mark the response you want on the OMR Answer Sheet.
There shall be negative marking for all Objective/MCQ type questions. For each incorrect answer in the MCQ, one-third (1/3rd) of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted.
